title: Translation checklist and gates
description:
As an editor, I want a localization's checklist proven by records, so no step can be ticked by hand and the reader label tells the truth.

Design: section 3.9. A localization is an ordinary Story lineage; its checklist template is the plan's translation procedure document. Steps: `translate`, `faithfulness`, `copy_edit`, `publish`, and optional `corrector_review` (never blocks, drives the reader label). Per Ryan 2026-11-13 no paid reviewer exists, so `corrector_review` only ever records a volunteer correction or a "Looks right" press; the page stays labelled as AI-translated until one happens.

```gherkin
Feature: A localization's checklist is proven by records
  Scenario: The steps cannot be ticked by hand
    Given a Chinese localization
    When someone tries to mark "faithfulness" done
    Then it is refused, because only a finished check of the current version proves it

  Scenario: Copy-edit is proven by the convergence loop's final check
    Given a localization whose polish rounds converged
    Then the "copy_edit" step is done
    And it names the check run of the current version for every enabled lane

  Scenario: A corrector's review changes the label, not the gate
    Given a published Chinese page nobody has reviewed
    When a corrector presses "Looks right"
    Then the page says it was translated by AI and reviewed by a person

  Scenario: The English Story is never held by its translations
    Given a Chinese localization held on a faithfulness error
    Then the English Story's checklist and page are unaffected
```
